text: ‘Only the rich and powerful benefit from globalisation.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Aid programmes are ineffective in reducing poverty in developing countries.’ Evaluate this view.
‘Audiences have no influence on the content of the media.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Representations of women in the media reflect patriarchal values.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘Religion is an instrument of social control.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
‘People are just as religious today as in the past.’ Evaluate this view. [35]
